messages:
Ava (AE): Heads up 10: MonetBank wants a POC with EU-only inference, strict subprocessor visibility, and tenant pin. Can we confirm feasibility + quick cost delta? Need customer-facing blurb and a quote with BYOK as an optional line item.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Feasible. Key Qs: do they require control plane in EU as well or just inference/data egress? Also are they asking for HSM-backed keys or BYOK via KMS?
Ava (AE): They said 'EU-only data path' and 'BYOK preferred if doable'. No named HSM vendor yet.
Jamal (Infra): Implementation notes: tenant_pin -> route inference workers to eu-west-1, keep KV/cache local. This prevents cross-region autoscale; expect capacity uplift ~+15%-30% depending on concurrent sessions and prompt lengths. Also needs IP allowlist, peered VPC or tenant connector, and cert rotation plan.
Priya (SalesOps): For pricing: I need two options for the quote: hosted + geo-pin vs dedicated reserved. Any rough %s I can show?
Marco (Solutions Eng): Rough compare: hosted + geo-pin: quicker to stand up for POC, add routing/egress surcharge (~+10-15% per-token) and possible burst charges. Dedicated reserved: +20-40% baseline monthly commit but predictable per-unit pricing and avoids most cross-region egress. BYOK/HSM: one-time integration & validation fee (estimate $4k-$6k) and 1-2 week coordination.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Example customer-facing blurb to send:

"For strict EU data residency we recommend either a hosted tenant-pin POC or Dedicated reserved capacity. Tenant-pin is fastest for getting a POC running and keeps inference and egress within EU, though it can raise per-token costs due to constrained pooling and routing. Dedicated capacity provides predictable latency and unit cost for regulated production workloads but requires a monthly commitment and longer setup. BYOK/HSM is supported as an add-on but incurs additional onboarding and legal steps"

LegalBot: Action items 1: attach current subprocessors inventory, DPA, SCCs, and SOC2 report. For BYOK/HSM confirm KMIP/HSM vendor compatibility; signed addendum required before provisioning.
Ava (AE): Good. Marco can you also draft a short ops checklist I can hand to the customer's infra team?
Marco (Solutions Eng): Ops checklist (short):
- Confirm EU region (eu-west-1) for inference workers and egress.
- Decide control plane preference (EU-only vs global).
- Provide IP ranges for allowlist and VPC peering details.
- Confirm BYOK approach and KMS/HSM vendor details.
- Test cert rotation and key access flows.
- Perf smoke tests: 95th-p99 latency, token throughput targets.
- Rollback/fallback policy (note: disabling fallback increases outage risk during region incidents).

Jamal (Infra): Ops caveat: if they require 'no control plane fallback' we should document an outage plan. Also POC infra uplift: recommend +2 g4dn-equivalent GPUs for stable performance at typical POC concurrency.
Priya (SalesOps): Timeline suggestion: day 0 share docs + subprocessors CSV; day 3 infra handoff + IP whitelisting; day 7 deploy tenant pin & BYOK test (if chosen); day 10 perf runs; day 14 wrap and pricing decision. I'll draft the quote with hosted-pin vs dedicated lines + BYOK optional fee and include a one-time onboarding line.
Ava (AE): Perfect. I'll send Marco's blurb + Priya's draft quote to the contact. Priya, pls include the DPA link and subprocessors CSV.
Priya (SalesOps): Will do. Targeting EOD for draft quote.
Marco (Solutions Eng): I'll follow up with a config snippet and the routing_policy example they can review.
Ava (AE): Thanks team 603
